verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own docs describe Automations that schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline without user involvement, and automations can be paused and resumed without deleting them. This covers both recurring scheduling and autonomous background execution. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations work reliably; documentation of non-schedule (event-based) triggers and of agentic tool use within automated runs.
